reviews.title: Personify ruins Gympass app
reviews.text: This app is infuriating, and always blocks me from using gympass and wellhub. Personify IT staff ignore my tickets and don’t respond. Good luck getting help with this apps terrible service.

reviews.title: Becoming a chore
reviews.text: Over time, the app has become more of a chore than a valuable health support tool. I now simply click boxes and see how much money I get for the quarter. The tracking device is not always correct, and then I get frustrated that I won’t make my numbers. The points needed keeps rising. Instead of helping , the app is a burden. I used to take time reading articles and learning. Now, I just make sure to get points. What was the purpose of this application? Is it still serving that purpose? I will now take the money and shut up .

reviews.title: Disappointing and needy
reviews.text: I have used 4 similar programs with mobile apps in the past and this program is by far the most demanding and least rewarding. The app reflects that and goes even further. I guess all the good reviews are because people never tried anything else and are not aware that most of the content they can find online for free anyway. Mediocre wellness program aside, the app is way too demanding and confusing - many simple activities requt a series of actions to achieve a simple thing because they are hidden deep behind unintuitive menus. But at the same time you are bothered with suggestions on the home page you couldn’t care less but cannot remove or hide or replace with what is relevant to you. Almost half of the options are not even available in the app and open a webpage to another vendor instead so you the app behaves as a browser. Finally, integration with tracking devices is way too limited and they keep dropping support for them but not adding new ones. And even the ones that are supported don’t sync most data. But the most annoying part is that you don’t get awarded any points for data being collected because they have rigid rules about what qualifies for points. Like I make 20k steps and spend hours in various activities throughout the day but only a fraction of it gets rewarded. Strange having in mind it cones from the app that is supposed to promote ANY kind of activity and ANYTHING to help improving health as it should target anyone and everyone and bot just this who spen

HORRIBLE!

Instead, you get nothing for bunch of activities that APP promotes in the first place and then get notification badge with ghost notifications. On top of all that it uses a dozen of 3rd party services where you need to register for through SSO and share more of PII with?! No thank you!

reviews.title: Bait and Switch - Avoid at all costs!
reviews.text:
Their business model is dependent on selling you their technology, then retiring its ability to work so that you have to buy from them again.  Classic bait and switch.  If you are a company in search of improving the health of your staff, Personify Health is not the way to go about that.  Find someone else.  Reply to their response:   Here’s what they told me when I contacted them before coming here.  “It is understandable how frustrating this process can be. However, there is no trade in policy that can be done and no negotiations. However, you can enter steps manually that your Max Buzz tracks or navigate to our platform store and purchase the Max GO.”   I repeat - they sell you a product and then turn into nothing but a pedometer that doesn’t connect so that you have to buy something else that they will eventually disconnect later.  No thanks.  My previous comment stands.

A few months later and this app has gone from bad to worse, first closing without allowing you to open it with some age block that is way younger than you are, and then taking you places where you don’t want to go.  It almost looks like it may have been hacked.

reviews.title: Great in theory, lacking in execution
reviews.text: This app was presented to me through my employer as a one stop shop for empowering me in my personal health journey. All of our other health platforms would be integrated and I could complete activities to earn the health premium discounts that used to be awarded after a single annual heath assessment / biometric screening. In reality the systems don’t connect due to improper integration / data share issues / or API breakages. And their customer support app is woefully underdeveloped - a simple inquiry takes 1hour+ to not get a resolution. I’ve been handed off multiple times due to timeouts, agents don’t respond, and the conversations disconnects. While the platform is great in theory (small packets of doable health tips / activities) real people trying to do right and save money are held hostage to a platform that doesn’t have the ability to execute basic technical services and functionality.

reviews.title: App Not Functioning Properly, Support Unhelpful
reviews.text:
My employer requires this app to qualify for medical premium discounts. It worked well in 2025, but the 2026 experience has introduced multiple glitches and inconsistent support responses.

The daily card experience has changed in a confusing way. Users receive credit for completing 2 daily cards, yet the app now presents 10 cards per day. In 2025, daily cards and company announcements appeared in the same section but were clearly distinguishable. At some point, they were separated into different sections altogether.

Support recently told me the additional cards are “announcements,” but that explanation doesn’t align with how the app is currently structured. Announcements are already separated from daily cards. The issue appears to be with how daily cards are being surfaced or categorized.

More concerning, a new issue started this week where I only receive credit for completing 2 cards after clicking 3. That creates confusion about eligibility tracking, which is especially problematic when this app directly impacts insurance premium discounts.

When I reached out to report these issues, I was told the app is working as intended. That response felt dismissive and did not reflect an effort to investigate user feedback.

I hope the product team reviews both the daily card logic and the credit tracking behavior.

reviews.title: Not a fan of the app
reviews.text: The reason I gave this app 2 stars is because the information is not personalized to each company. Maybe that sounds crazy but in my opinion it should not be in this day and age. My complaint starts with the fact that my company uses this app now instead of Virgin Pulse (used last year and the year before). Under my rewards it would state how many days I have left to use my rewards. Unfortunately each company ends their program on different days but the app is not personalized to each company so the date I see is a general date. That was not the case in previous years. When I lost my rewards and I called my HR dept and the websites support, neither was of any help to me. I basically lost out on my rewards due to misleading information in the app. I saved my rewards specifically for Xmas and lost out on money I earned using the health app. Ridiculous! If I could switch apps and decide which one I want to earn points through , I def would.
